title: Executable Definition of Done release gate
userStory: As a contract-operations product owner, I can verify that each major feature has complete, source-linked delivery evidence before it is declared done.

criteria.rationale: This feature is a non-interactive repository and CI gate; its CLI provides explicit pass and error output but introduces no loading or empty application view.
The gate has no browser-to-server rule boundary; one shared validator owns both local and CI manifest validation.
The checker is read-only and performs no database, object-storage, or other material runtime writes.
No D1 schema or seeded production data changes are part of this repository-governance feature.
The read-only gate neither creates nor deletes R2 objects and cannot leave database and file state inconsistent.
No HTTP API or authorization surface is introduced; malformed and incomplete manifest inputs are covered by validator tests.
The official contract and supplier data model is unchanged, so exports and assistant retrieval require no update.

evidence.ref: 16 of 16 roadmap criteria explicitly accounted for

metric.name: Roadmap 14 criteria explicitly accounted for
metric.value: 16 of 16 criteria (100%); applicability only, not production outcome quality
